profile_text.body:
The Krita Foundation is a nonprofit, open-source foundation that develops and maintains Krita, a digital art application distributed freely to users. The foundation operates under a community governance model, meaning development decisions and project direction are shaped by its contributor community rather than by commercial shareholders or investors.

On the AI side, the foundation offers what it describes as Krita AI, which integrates local AI plugins into the Krita application. The product is notable for having no cloud dependency, meaning AI features run on the user's own hardware rather than through external hosted services. This approach aligns with the foundation's broader open-source and community-centered philosophy, keeping user data and processing local.

The held facts confirm the foundation has an active page in the registry, classify it as a nonprofit open-source foundation, and place Krita AI in the image and graphic design category. No litigation, SEC filings, patent records, or MCP server registrations are on file for the organization.
